RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a quarrel between neighbours
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: Two factions bring a dispute to the lord rather than settle it with soldiers.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.arrivalText:
{PETITIONER_labelShort} of {FIRST} and {OTHER_labelShort} of {SECOND} have come to the gate together, which neighbours who are quarrelling do not usually manage. The quarrel is {QUARREL}, and they have brought it here rather than settle it with soldiers.
Neither has any hold over the lord. That is the point of asking him. They will wait {DAYS} days for an audience, and whatever he says, one of them goes home having lost.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText:
{PETITIONER_labelShort} speaks for {FIRST}, {OTHER_labelShort} for {SECOND}, and the quarrel is {QUARREL}. Both accounts are complete and they agree nowhere it matters. Both have agreed in advance to be bound by whatever this chair says, which is a great deal of trust to put in a stranger.
One of them leaves having lost, and both will remember which.
How does the lord rule?

li.label: Rule for whichever of them puts {SILVER} silver on the table
li.pastLabel: the ruling went to the one who paid

li.label: Send them both away unheard
li.pastLabel: sent away to settle it themselves
